title: Conditional κ = .0038981730255 (+0.00002286456239785616% over #8053; +0.00005196026546808747% over #8052): unsplit two Gaussian returns
body:
## Result

**Conditional κ = 0.0038981730255 (+0.00002286456239785616% over #8053).** The preceding independently reproduced result is [#8053](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8053) at scientific revision `e25494616bf149217644ce08d949181ea3600e13`, κ = 0.0038981721342. The exact gain is 0.0000000008913 and the exact percentage is `(148550/6496953557)%`. The latest external comparable peer [#8052](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8052), `baaec65bf8e4c7e92be110a00d5b06522177931f`, independently reproduces κ = 0.003898171. Against that peer the exact increase is 0.0000000020255, or `(4051/77963420)%` (approximately +0.00005196026546808747%). The selected record is #7000.

## Construction

Keep the base-copy packet whole at paid return ordinals 1,592 and 1,593, tags `(return, 9977, 0, 91990)` and `(return, 9977, 0, 91966)`. The original two ordered half-rank requests at either site partition the same owner and axes. The native right and left monomial actions, token lifetime, and restoration stay on the original signed path. Exact positive and negative controls confirm the partition, aliasing, and physical geometry. The charged inventory changes from 564,144 to 564,142. The original 105,216 numerical targets and 54 transport cells are priced at the same carrier heights. A directed capacity bound excludes 1,005 splits. The preceding 1,008-split inventory has strictly negative raw margin at the new exact trial `133940467/2^35`. [Capacity proof and clean replay](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a636a3892e7036b782168bbba260419c6b2be309/paired-768/r368/README.md)

## Verification

All eight registered scientific modes passed locally on the exact scientific tree at `40940734cf582ded0896833b3dc93880299cf927`. The signed product is −345550037539, with 138 shuttles and 157,248 H calls. Independent directed prices, the complete transport, the signed charts, and three adapter controls replayed successfully. Local onboarding ran 760 tests with 31 skips and exited zero. The submission head `f6f4ecd5dd717ce2b155dd564469e9693ac90f6d` distributes the same eight verifier invocations between two bounded hosted jobs so the longer installation/receiver checks have their own time budget.

```sh
python3.12 -IB scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-gaussian-unsplit-returns
python3.12 -IB scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-gaussian-unsplit-returns-installation
```

The proof inherits the same five obligations for all-column native action, ownership/restoration, uniform compilation, tape and precision, and analytic recovery. The measurements cover exact signed finite replay and the priced conditional implication. Full production-scale execution and a formal proof of the inherited framework remain open.

On submitted head `f6f4ecd5dd717ce2b155dd564469e9693ac90f6d`, all four hosted checks passed. The main scientific job emitted all six markers including the signed product. The companion job reproduced the full fixed installation in 196.555 seconds and each of the 64,800 noncommuting receiver comparisons. [Full hosted run](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/45065730845) · [Main scientific replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/45065730845/job/137342454170) · [Installation and receiver replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/45065730845/job/137342454243)
